text:
Alex G: Heads up — Token cost dashboard showing $0 / NaN for about a dozen orgs (mostly EU/SG). First noticed 2026-03-16 18:20 UTC. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/snap/IMG_20260316.png
Priya R: Which org ids? any customer tickets yet?
Alex G: Quick list: org_82, org_129, org_211. Two incoming support tickets so far.
Alex G: Paste of the query I ran:
```sql
SELECT org_id, sum(tokens) AS tokens, sum(cost) AS cost, avg(cost/tokens) AS cost_per_token
FROM billing_hourly
WHERE day >= '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY org_id;
```
Alex G: For those orgs `cost` is 0 or `cost_per_token` shows NaN. Other orgs look fine.
Chen L: I'm spinning up a query against raw_ingest to see if cost was missing during the kafka->warehouse backfill. Will share rows.
Maya S: UI note: frontend gets numeric values and formats NaN -> "NaN" and null -> becomes $0.00 after coalesce in the view. We should not display $0 for nulls.
ops-bot: CI:deployment finished by @ci/cd (deploy id 2145678500) — staging->prod completed 18:07 UTC.
Priya R: Priority? If invoices are fine this might be UI-only, but customers see $0 and are worried.
Alex G: Two enterprise contacts flagged it and asked for explanation. They confirm invoices show charges.
Chen L: Quick log snippet from the transform job:
```
2026-03-16T18:01:12Z WARN transform: missing rate for model_id=rtg-3 -> cost=null, tokens=0
2026-03-16T18:01:12Z INFO write to hourly_ingest partition=2026-03-16-18 rows=24
```
Chen L: Looks like when rate is null we currently emit cost=null. Downstream materialized view has `coalesce(cost, 0)` which produces $0 and the `avg(cost/tokens)` becomes NaN when tokens=0. So two separate failure modes.
Maya S: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) UI change to render null/NaN as "—" and never show $0 for nulls, 2) Update SQL to avoid dividing when tokens=0 and filter null costs from per-token aggregates.
Priya R: Can data pipeline team patch transform? If we can stop coalescing in the MV and treat nulls consistently that's ideal.
Chen L: I'll hotfix the transform to set `cost = null` (no change) but update the materialized view to `WHERE tokens > 0 AND cost IS NOT NULL` for per-token aggregates. I'll push change to prod transform+MV refresh. ETA ~90m.
Maya S: I'll add a short-term client-side guard that maps NaN -> null and displays "—" so customers don't see $0. That can be feature-flagged and rolled in 30m.
Priya R: I'll draft customer-facing message and open an incident with billing/data/front-end and tag SRE.
Alex G: Repro steps for support engineers: 1) open token cost dashboard, 2) filter by org id (e.g., org_129), 3) window last 24h, 4) toggle per-token breakdown — verify $0/NaN.
Priya R: Thanks — please paste the MV ddl and the patch PR here when ready.
Chen L: Will do. Also scheduling a post-mortem to review why null cost went through and why coalesce was used.
Alex G: Thanks all — ping me if you need more examples or the original CSV export. :thumbsup:
